publicationDecision.scope: Publish the reviewed investigational summaries through the guarded workflow; this is editorial authorisation, not clinical approval.

reviewType: AI-assisted primary-source factual review; not clinical approval

entries.name: MBX 4291
entries.stage: Phase 1 recruiting; preliminary blinded sponsor data
entries.summary: A long-acting GLP-1/GIP co-agonist peptide prodrug being studied in adults with obesity. MBX reported preliminary blinded eight-week data from a small Phase 1 cohort on 11 May 2026. The registry remained recruiting at its 9 June 2026 update and has no posted results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for MBX 4291.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Trial development does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The reported cohort contained eight people including two receiving placebo, remained blinded, and was not a completed controlled result. Once-monthly dosing is a development aim, not an authorised regimen.

additionalEvidence.title: MBX Biosciences obesity portfolio update
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read for Phase 1 design, preliminary blinded data and planned dosing; not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07142707
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry API read for recruiting Phase 1 status, actual 3 September 2025 start, estimated 124 participants and no posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: ARO-INHBE
entries.summary: An RNA-interference programme designed to reduce hepatic INHBE expression and Activin E. Arrowhead reported interim Phase 1/2a metabolic and body-composition findings on 27 May 2026. The registry remained recruiting at its 25 September update and has no posted results.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for ARO-INHBE.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Research participation does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Interim sponsor-reported findings from an early, dose-escalating study do not establish efficacy, approval or a future dosing interval. Liver-fat and imaging measures are not interchangeable with long-term weight, strength or clinical outcomes.

additionalEvidence.title: Arrowhead ARO-INHBE EASL 2026 update
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read for interim Phase 1/2a findings and limitations; not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06700538
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry API read for recruiting Phase 1/2 status, actual 4 December 2024 start, estimated 180 participants and no posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: LX9851
entries.summary: An oral non-incretin small-molecule ACSL5 inhibitor licensed by Novo Nordisk from Lexicon. The companies announced first-in-human Phase 1 initiation on 23 March 2026 in people with overweight or obesity; completion was expected in the first quarter of 2027.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for LX9851.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The reviewed announcement confirms initiation, not results. The ClinicalTrials.gov exact-name search performed for this review returned no matching record, so current recruitment and dates were not independently verified.

additionalEvidence.title: Lexicon and Novo Nordisk LX9851 Phase 1 initiation
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original joint sponsor announcement read for mechanism, initiation and planned completion; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: NBIP-1968
entries.summary: A once-weekly investigational GLP-1/GIP/glucagon receptor triple agonist. Neurocrine announced first-in-human Phase 1 initiation on 7 August 2026 and described intended later fixed-dose-combination development with its separate Phase 1 CRF2 agonist NBIP-2118.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for NBIP-1968 or the proposed combination.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The reviewed announcement confirms initiation of single-ascending-dose research, not efficacy or combination results. The proposed fixed-dose combination is a development intention, not a completed study or approved regimen.

additionalEvidence.title: Neurocrine NBIP-1968 Phase 1 initiation
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read for Phase 1 initiation, formulation and proposed combination; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: CRB-913
entries.stage: Phase 1b topline sponsor results; Phase 2 planned
entries.summary: A once-daily oral, peripherally restricted CB1 inverse agonist. Corbus reported CANYON-1 topline Phase 1b results on 14 September 2026 after 12 weeks of treatment. A Phase 2 monotherapy study was planned for the first half of 2027, not yet treated as started.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for CRB-913.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Sponsor-reported topline data have not been treated as a head-to-head comparison. The registry still showed active, not recruiting, at its 29 May 2026 update and had no posted results; the later sponsor announcement is the evidence for completion and findings.

additionalEvidence.title: Corbus CANYON-1 topline results
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read for study design, topline findings, adverse events and planned Phase 2; not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07310901
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry API read for Phase 1b design and stale active-not-recruiting status; no posted results; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: SYNT-101
entries.summary: An investigational daily oral tablet intended to create a transient lining in the small intestine and alter nutrient absorption. Syntis reported initial single-ascending-dose safety and pharmacodynamic observations on 16 July 2026; a 28-day multiple-dose cohort in people with overweight or obesity had completed enrolment, with data still planned.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for SYNT-101.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Clinical development does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: The reported human data were from 32 healthy volunteers after single doses and did not establish weight loss or muscle preservation. Multiple-dose results and proposed GLP-1 combinations remain unreported in the reviewed evidence.

additionalEvidence.title: Syntis SYNT-101 initial Phase 1/1b data
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor announcement read for single-dose findings, mechanism and planned multiple-dose reporting; not automatically content-monitored.

entries.name: ALV-100
entries.summary: A GIP-receptor-antagonist/GLP-1-receptor-agonist fusion protein being studied for weight maintenance after semaglutide-associated weight loss. Alveus announced first-patient dosing in the Phase 2 PRESERVE study on 14 September 2026; the registry showed recruiting with an actual 10 August 2026 start at its 28 September update.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation for ALV-100.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Research participation does not establish lawful UK retail supply or pharmacy stock.
entries.limitations: Recruitment and first dosing are not results. The maintenance population is selected after at least 10% weight loss on semaglutide; findings cannot be assumed for general obesity treatment or other prior medicines.

additionalEvidence.title: Alveus PRESERVE Phase 2 initiation
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Original sponsor-distributed announcement read for study population, design and initiation; not automatically content-monitored.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07837973
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry API read for recruiting Phase 2 status, actual 10 August 2026 start, estimated 220 participants and no posted results; not automatically content-monitored.
